title: Articles of Confederation
creator: Continental Congress
theme: confederation; institutional capacity
evidence_role: Direct evidence of the initial federal structure and retained state sovereignty
notes: Use the archival citation and transcript separately; do not treat the NARA contextual essay as primary text.

title: Constitution of the United States
creator: Constitutional Convention
theme: constitutional capacity; union; taxation; commerce
evidence_role: Direct evidence of the powers and representational compromises of the new federal framework
notes: The transcription includes the three-fifths clause and other evidence necessary to analyze unequal incorporation.

title: Northwest Ordinance
creator: Confederation Congress
theme: territorial governance; state admission; expansion
evidence_role: Direct evidence of the institutional method for governing territory and admitting states
notes: Analyze territorial integration together with Indigenous dispossession rather than as administrative expansion alone.

title: Treaty of Paris
creator: United States and Great Britain
theme: sovereignty; territorial extent; diplomacy
evidence_role: Direct evidence of the formal settlement ending the Revolutionary War
notes: Record the complete item landing page before extracting images or text.

title: A map of the British and French dominions in North America
creator: John Mitchell
theme: imperial geography; boundaries; continental scale
evidence_role: Geographic context for the territorial system inherited and contested by the United States
notes: LOC notes that this map was later used in establishing the 1783 boundaries.

title: Western Land Claims and Territorial Organizations, 1783–1812
creator: Albert Bushnell Hart; Francis J. Reynolds
theme: western claims; territorial organization; state formation
evidence_role: Retrospective visualization of overlapping claims and territorial reorganization
notes: This is a later interpretive map, not a contemporaneous 1780s source.

title: Alexander Hamilton Papers
creator: Alexander Hamilton and others
theme: public credit; administration; correspondence
evidence_role: Archival collection for tracing fiscal proposals, correspondence, and implementation
notes: Verify the canonical collection landing page and use item-level records for individual documents.

title: Report on Additional Sums Necessary for the Support of Government
creator: Alexander Hamilton
theme: fiscal capacity; federal administration
evidence_role: Direct evidence from Hamilton’s Treasury-era writings
notes: This is not the First Report on Public Credit; retain the precise title and date.

title: Return of the Whole Number of Persons within the Several Districts of the United States
creator: United States census authorities
theme: population; representation; slavery; territorial baseline
evidence_role: Direct quantitative baseline for population and constitutional apportionment
notes: Counts reflect historical categories and exclusions, including enslaved persons and Indians not taxed; preserve original definitions.

title: 1790 Population Map
creator: United States Census Bureau
theme: population density; settlement geography
evidence_role: Derived visualization of the first census population distribution
notes: Treat as a modern visualization compiled from historical census records.

title: Records of the Continental and Confederation Congresses and the Constitutional Convention
creator: United States federal record creators
theme: constitutional design; confederation; western lands
evidence_role: Archival discovery guide for convention records, votes, plans, and transmitted documents
notes: A discovery record, not itself evidence for a substantive historical claim.

title: Constitution of the United States—A History
creator: National Archives and Records Administration
theme: ratification; Federalist debate; institutional failure
evidence_role: Secondary institutional context and discovery path to related primary documents
notes: Use for orientation and links; cite primary documents for historical claims.

title: An Act to regulate the collection of duties on imports and tonnage
creator: United States Congress
repository_identifier: 1 Stat. 627; Fifth Congress, Sess. III, ch. 22
theme: customs administration; ports; enforcement; federal capacity
evidence_role: Direct legal evidence for the collection machinery governing imports and tonnage
notes: This is principally a collection and administration statute, not merely a tariff-rate schedule; cite sections and page images for specific claims.

title: Annual Report of the Secretary of the Treasury on the State of the Finances
creator: United States Department of the Treasury
institution: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRASER
theme: public finance; revenue; expenditures; debt; customs
evidence_role: Title-level discovery source for annual and special Treasury reports and fiscal tables
notes: Use issue-level records and page citations in analysis. FRASER notes that early years were bound into volumes and that OCR can contain errors.

title: Excerpts from the American State Papers: 1792
creator: United States Department of the Treasury
institution: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRASER
theme: import duties; public revenue; receipts; expenditures
evidence_role: Quantitative primary evidence for early federal revenue, including the net product of import duties
notes: Transcribe from page images and record table title, period, units, and page; use OCR only as a finding aid.

title: Records of the United States Customs Service
creator: United States Customs Service and predecessor offices
theme: customs districts; port operations; vessels; duties; enforcement
evidence_role: Archival discovery guide for operational records behind national customs aggregates
notes: The collection is very large and only partly digitized. Create item- or series-level records before treating any underlying document as evidence.

title: Mercantile collection
creator: Various merchants, firms, and companies
theme: trade; finance; insurance; shipping; merchant networks
evidence_role: Discovery source for private commercial records, especially New York and Philadelphia mercantile activity
notes: Broad synthetic collection compiled from multiple provenances. Create component- or item-level records before using evidence; most access requires an in-person appointment.

title: Gelston and Saltonstall ledger
creator: Gelston & Saltonstall
theme: merchant accounts; New York commerce; regional trade
evidence_role: Firm-level evidence on the accounts of a prominent New York City mercantile partnership
bibframe_alignment: Work; Manuscript; Item; Archival finding aid
notes: The public record is a collection description, not a digitized ledger. Inspect the physical volume before extracting counterparties, commodities, values, or balances.

title: Stewart and Jones records
creator: Stewart and Jones; Jones and Ross; associated creators
source_type: merchant and ship-chandler records; finding aid
theme: ship supplies; accounts; correspondence; New York commerce
evidence_role: Firm-level evidence on merchant and ship-chandler operations during the Confederation and early federal periods
notes: Selected 1776–1783 material is on microfilm, but the collection generally requires in-person access. Separate commercial records from John Jones’s Trinity Church records.

title: Morris & Ludlum letter and order book
creator: Morris & Ludlum; James Ludlum
source_type: merchant letter and order book; finding aid
theme: hardware imports; Atlantic trade; commodities; merchant credit and orders
evidence_role: Firm-level evidence on New York orders to British and southern merchants, with founding-era entries concentrated in 1797–1799
bibframe_alignment: Work; Manuscript; Item; Archival finding aid
notes: The volume later became James Ludlum’s farm and mill ledger. Restrict the founding-period tranche to the firm’s 1797–1799 letters and orders and inspect the physical volume before transcription.

title: Vessel manifests and entrance and clearance records in Records of the United States Customs Service
creator: United States customs collectors and customhouses
theme: vessel movements; ports; cargo; tonnage; masters; customs administration
evidence_role: Primary administrative basis for reconstructing arrivals, departures, cargo processing, and vessel documentation by customs district
notes: The guide identifies relevant functions and series but is not a voyage dataset. Add series-, container-, and item-level identifiers before extraction; survival and digitization vary sharply by port.

title: Civilian Records Relating to Slavery: Records of the United States Customs Service
creator: United States Customs Service and predecessor offices
theme: slave trade enforcement; coastwise voyages; manifests; forced migration
evidence_role: Discovery guide connecting customs records to the federal regulation and documentation of voyages carrying enslaved people
notes: The guide explains inward and outward slave manifests and their fields. Most coastwise manifests postdate the core 1790s window; use them for institutional continuity, not as direct evidence of 1790s voyage patterns.

title: SlaveVoyages: Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade Database
creator: Multiple scholarly contributors and archival projects
theme: transatlantic slave trade; voyages; vessels; captains; embarkation; disembarkation
evidence_role: Voyage-level structured evidence for the coerced-migration and slave-trading component of Atlantic commerce
notes: A derived and periodically updated scholarly database, not a single archive. Preserve database version or access date, voyage ID, field definitions, and source citations; distinguish documented from imputed values.

title: Voyages: The Transatlantic Slave Trade Database
creator: National Endowment for the Humanities; Emory University project team
theme: database provenance; methodology; voyage variables
evidence_role: Independent institutional documentation of the database’s development, contributors, coverage, and voyage-level fields
notes: Use as provenance and methodological context, not as a substitute for the database records or their underlying archival citations.
